## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Zabeel Park, Gate No- 6 & 7 Area - B - Dubai - United Arab Emirates.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dubai loves nothing more than doing everything bigger and better than before! This mesmerizing medley of light and creative installations is a must-see in the city and your camera will get a real work out too.
>
> Your tickets to Dubai Garden Glow in Zabeel Park get you access to four amazing themed worlds, some stunning artistic light installations, including a walk-through Dinosaur Park, educational activities and a live music show. This one-of-a-kind expansive garden of more than a million energy-saving LED lights is one efficient work of art!

## Where this page comes from
